description: Punctuation variants that do NOT alter clause boundaries.

candidate_sets.pattern: sentence-initial connective (Thus/Therefore/Hence/So/Then/Next/Now) followed by optional comma

candidate_sets.note: Only when the line is a complete standalone step ending in a value or expression; never when the period disambiguates sentence structure.

exclusions: colon/semicolon swaps — EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED per freeze
any comma whose presence/absence changes clause attachment or list structure
serial/Oxford commas — EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED per freeze
decimal points, thousands separators, or any numeral-internal punctuation
